decision.rule: A primary difference model wins only when the sequence-equal 95% interval of (its MAE - the single-image MAE) lies entirely below 0 for energy, fat, carb, and protein, and the same interval against its random cross-plate control lies entirely below 0 for energy. Otherwise a stop rule fires. Ablations are not eligible to be selected.
